rationale: Independently rebuilt the exact generated catalog from the current bound 57-item candidate and both complete reviews; package proposal bytes match. Re-ran the actual serving audit to a separate file and obtained byte-identical evidence, verifying every runtime source fingerprint, all 75 existing KG snapshots/provenance, all recipes and all nine optional goals. Additionally replayed 100 randomized discovery orders while changing goals between crafts: each reached all 39 crafted results and 28 supplied ingredients, with no dead end, all 57 stable repeat outcomes and no goal-dependent recipe change. Public snapshots disclose only discovered target IDs and no private recipe book. The four corrected descriptions and sugar-syrup/butter explanation remain exactly reviewed. This accepts factual content and consistency in the separate culinary discovery world, not a claim that legacy challenge recipes were globally reconciled.
